This APi resource is used to control the progress of your Verify Requests
  - Send a Verify request.
  - Check the response.
  
  Following are possible values of "status" in the response.(Code =  Command :  Error Text : Meaning)
  
  - 0 = Success :  Success : Success.
  - 19 = Cancel  Verification requests can't be cancelled within the first 30 seconds  :  You must wait at least 30s after sending a Verify Request before cancelling.
  - 19 =  Cancel : Verification requests can't be cancelled no
